_note: DEFAULT-DENY allowance for the skip gate (tests/skip_gate.py). Every skip reason that occurs, whatever its wording, must appear here with its exact count; there is no allow-list of 'known' wordings. classify()/COMPILE_ENV_PATTERNS only label the log lines and name which reasons the 'engine_built' profile pins at 0. Keys are the EXACT skip reason text (a renamed reason is drift too). 'default' is the profile the engine-less hosted-CI pytest job runs; its counts are the WHOLE skip population of the measured run (2,358 skips across 13 reasons), not only the compile-environment ones. 'engine_built' is the profile the engine-building CI job runs: the compile-environment reasons are pinned at 0 so any such skip fails that job; see _engine_built_note.
_measured_on: 2026-10-11 spot box (Ubuntu 24.04, python 3.12), engine-less with NO PINEFORGE_* variables set; the counts are the WHOLE skip population of that run (2,358 skips across 13 reasons), not only the compile-environment skips
_engine_built_note: UNMEASURED. The engine-building CI job runs this profile, but the counts below are NOT a measurement of that job: they are copies of the engine-less `default` run and are EXPECTED to be WRONG. That job neither sets PINEFORGE_ENGINE_CORPUS nor PINEFORGE_STRING_SETTINGS_SOURCES (the parity corpus and the population sources are private submodules absent from the public pineforge-engine clone the job checks out), so its corpus and population tests do not run and its counts WILL differ from the engine-less job's. Expect the FIRST engine-built run to FAIL and the gate to print the exact rows to write here; paste those rows in to measure this profile. The compile-environment rows (the 'PINEFORGE_ENGINE_INCLUDE not set or invalid...' and 'set PINEFORGE_ENGINE_INCLUDE...' rows, 'engine include / compiler unavailable', 'set PINEFORGE_ENGINE_INCLUDE plus a valid pineforge-engine corpus checkout...', 'population sources require PINEFORGE_STRING_SETTINGS_SOURCES', 'PINEFORGE_ENGINE_CORPUS is needed for emitted-byte comparison', 'input receipt corpus pin requires PINEFORGE_ENGINE_CORPUS') must stay 0: building the engine must remove every one.
